display_name.description: User defined name of this taxonomy. The taxonomy display name must be unique within an organization. It must: contain only unicode letters, numbers, underscores, dashes and spaces; not start or end with spaces; and be at most 200 bytes long when encoded in UTF-8.
display_name.rationale: This is only a human-readable display name and does not control access to the resource or data.

description.description: Description of this taxonomy. It must: contain only unicode characters, tabs, newlines, carriage returns and page breaks; and be at most 2000 bytes long when encoded in UTF-8. If not set, defaults to an empty description.
description.rationale: This is only descriptive metadata and does not control access to the resource or data.

activated_policy_types.description: A list of policy types that are activated for this taxonomy. If not set, defaults to an empty list. Each value may be one of: `POLICY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, `FINE_GRAINED_ACCESS_CONTROL`.
activated_policy_types.rationale: Fine-grained access control should be enabled so the taxonomy can support sensitive data access control.

region.rationale: Taxonomies should be created only in approved regions to meet data residency and governance requirements.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project ID is an identifier for locating the resource and does not by itself enforce a security control.
